primary.title: ITR deadline: Who must file returns by 31 October, what is the penalty for missed deadline? Key points to know
primary.summary: ITR deadline: Companies and taxpayers whose accounts are required to be audited, the due date for FY26 / AY27 is 31 October. Here's a look at the penalty for missed deadline and date for belated returns.

related.title: Missed 31 August ITR deadline? Here's what taxpayers can do next — belated, revised and condonation options explained
related.summary: Missing the 31 August ITR deadline for AY 2026-27 does not end your filing options. Taxpayers can file a belated return by 31 December, revise an already filed return, or seek condonation of delay in eligible cases.
